nodes.title: Deliver the reusable voice customer-care platform boundary

nodes.thought: Define canonical manifest and artifact schemas that package knowledge, ontology, intents, response frames, forms, action references, policies, localization, branding, and evaluations under one root CID.
nodes.title: Define an immutable swappable domain-pack contract

nodes.title: Generalize the conversation and action DAG schema

nodes.title: Define typed action lifecycle contracts

nodes.title: Build the deployment-owned action catalog and resolver

nodes.title: Enforce policy capability consent and confirmation before execution

nodes.title: Add content-addressed idempotent execution receipts and replay

nodes.title: Implement the sandboxed CLI action adapter

nodes.title: Implement the registered Python callable adapter

nodes.title: Build human-handoff queue and transfer contracts

nodes.title: Define reusable intake forms and case lifecycle

nodes.thought: Expose session, turn, form, confirmation, action, handoff, status, resume, and cancellation operations through one service with HTTP/WebSocket adapters and stable error semantics.
nodes.title: Expose a transport-neutral customer-care gateway
